mapper.sql: case when to_char(CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and SEND_STATUS=#{NO_SUBMIT} then '01' when to_char(CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and to_char(SUBMIT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and SEND_STATUS=#{NO_SUBMIT} then '02' when to_char(SUBMIT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') > to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and SEND_STATUS=#{NO_SUBMIT} then '03' when to_char(SUBMIT_TIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd') = to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and SEND_STATUS = '03' then '04' when to_char(SUBMIT_TIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd') = to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and SEND_STATUS = '02' /*接口报送*/ and SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS in ('01', '03') then '05' when to_char(SUBMIT_TIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and SEND_STATUS = '02' /*接口报送*/ and SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS in ('02', '04', '05') then '06' when STATUS = '03'and SEND_STATUS = '01' and to_char(CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') then '07' end SEND_STATUS,

case when to_char(PR.PBC_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and PR.SEND_STATUS=#{NO_SUBMIT} then '01' when to_char(PR.PBC_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and to_char(PR.SUBMIT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and PR.SEND_STATUS=#{NO_SUBMIT} then '02' when to_char(PR.SUBMIT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') > to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and PR.SEND_STATUS=#{NO_SUBMIT} then '03' when to_char(PR.SUBMIT_TIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd') = to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and PR.SEND_STATUS = '03' then '04' when to_char(PR.SUBMIT_TIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd') = to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and PR.SEND_STATUS = '02' /*接口报送*/ and PR.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS in ('01', '03') then '05' when to_char(PR.SUBMIT_TIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and PR.SEND_STATUS = '02' /*接口报送*/ and PR.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS in ('02', '04', '05') then '06' when PR.STATUS = '03'and PR.SEND_STATUS = '01' and to_char(PR.PBC_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') then '07' end SEND_STATUS,
mapper.select: with checkwarn as (select count(check_result) warnnum,rep_code from chb_report_check where check_result='03' and to_char(DATA_TIME,'yyyy-mm-dd') = to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},'yyyy-mm-dd') group by rep_code ) ,checkfail as(select count(check_result) failnum,rep_code from chb_report_check where check_result='02' and to_char(DATA_TIME,'yyyy-mm-dd') = to_char(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},'yyyy-mm-dd') group by rep_code) select nvl(checkwarn.warnnum,0) warningnum /*预警*/ ,nvl(checkfail.failnum,0) failnum /*不通过*/ ,nvl(checkwarn.warnnum,0)+nvl(checkfail.failnum,0) as submitChecknum /*报送检查*/ ,nvl(checkwarn.rep_code,checkfail.rep_code) reporttype /*报表类型*/ from checkwarn full join checkfail on checkwarn.rep_code = checkfail.rep_code
